turns.text: ok can u make me a printable weekly schedule graphic pls, hour blocked, to pin above my desk
Happy to. Tell me what goes in it: classes (days and times), work shifts, and anything else that repeats weekly. And do you want specific colors for anything?

ok wait so classes: anatomy MWF 9am, general chem TTh 11am, and stats is online so just a flexible block somewhere

work is heron & grind, mon/wed 12-6 and sat/sun 6:30-1
Got it. Do you want class lengths shown, or just start times? If you're not sure, I'll use 1 hour for Anatomy and Chem and mark them as adjustable. Any colors you want?

yes colors pls, i want to match my notes. pink for muscles, blue for bones, green for nerves

anatomy can be pink and chem can be... idk blue? and stats green. work can be gray

and keep it short, just the grid no paragraphs
